criteria.name: card
criteria.expect: a 320x200 card at pos 0 0, white, radius 12, with auto-layout abs and the title Releases

criteria.name: badge
criteria.expect: a Badge use reading New, positioned with pos like the title

criteria.name: corner
criteria.expect: the badge's right edge is 8 points from the card's right edge and its top edge 8 points from the card's top edge

criteria.name: inside
criteria.expect: the badge stays inside the card bounds

criteria.name: render
criteria.expect: render Empty.Empty: a card with a New badge in its top-right corner, no warnings
